mapper.sql: id, namespace, original_name, storage_name, file_size, file_type, remark, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM file_info
ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_info (namespace, original_name, storage_name, file_size, file_type, remark, create_by, update_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{namespace}, #{originalName}, #{storageName}, #{fileSize}, #{fileType}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{updateBy}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE file_info SET namespace = #{namespace}, original_name = #{originalName}, storage_name = #{storageName}, file_size = #{fileSize}, file_type = #{fileType}, remark = #{remark}, create_by = #{createBy}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
